claims.text: PatchTST outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1 at horizon 336.
PatchTST is best characterised as patch-based channel-independent transformer.

evidence.description: Reported MSE reduction of 14% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336.

limitations.text: Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured.
Distribution shift between train and test periods is not explicitly modelled.

future_work.text: Applying the method to irregularly sampled clinical time series.
Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
